(views dashboards)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="140" x="1080" y="820" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a1" edge="1" parent="1" source="user" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;strokeWidth=2;" target="chat-ui"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a1l" connectable="0" parent="a1" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=11;" value="â types message" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.2" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="-27" y="-43" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a2" edge="1" parent="1" source="chat-ui" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;strokeWidth=2;" target="api-route"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a2l" connectable="0" parent="a2" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=11;" value="â¡ fetch /api/chat
(ndjson stream)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="-48" y="35" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a3" edge="1" parent="1" source="api-route" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;strokeWidth=2;" target="sdk-box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a3l" connectable="0" parent="a3" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=11;" value="â¢ pulse.chatStream()" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="-50" y="-73" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a4" edge="1" parent="1" source="api-route" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;strokeWidth=2;" target="postgres"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a4l" connectable="0" parent="a4" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=10;" value="â£ insert user msg
load history
insert assistant msg" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.2" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w6YA_zBqqIS8HLDbSKFX-3" connectable="0" parent="a4" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];" value="Text" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.6069" y="-5" as="geometry"> <mxPoint as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a5" edge="1" parent="1" source="sdk-box" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;strokeWidth=2;" target="llm"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a5l" connectable="0" parent="a5" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=10;" value="â¤ HTTPS to provider
(streaming SSE)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="-45" y="-80" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a6" edge="1" parent="1" source="sdk-box" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0;entryY=0.3;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;" target="ingest-http"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a6l" connectable="0" parent="a6" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=10;" value="â¥ batched LogEvents
POST /v1/logs every 1s
(fire-and-forget)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="-0.4" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a7" edge="1" parent="1" source="ingest-http" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;strokeWidth=2;" target="redis"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a7l" connectable="0" parent="a7" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=11;" value="â¦ XADD" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a8" edge="1" parent="1" source="redis" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.3;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;strokeWidth=2;" target="ingest-worker"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a8l" connectable="0" parent="a8" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=11;rotation=-15;" value="â§ XREADGROUP" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="-90" y="-13" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a9" edge="1" parent="1" source="ingest-worker" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.3;entryY=0;strokeWidth=2;" target="clickhouse"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a9l" connectable="0" parent="a9" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=10;" value="â¨ bulk insert
(JSONEachRow)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="10" y="-35" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a10" edge="1" parent="1" source="clickhouse" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;strokeWidth=2;" target="grafana"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a10l" connectable="0" parent="a10" style="edgeLabel;html=1;fontSize=10;" value="â© SELECT (dashboards)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-10" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a11" edge="1" parent="1" source="engineer" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;strokeWidth=2;" target="grafana"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-bg" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#ccc;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="340" width="580" x="60" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Legend / Reading Order" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="500" x="80" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-text" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=4;" value="â User types a message in the browser.
â¡ Browser POSTs to /api/chat â Next.js streams the response back as ndjson.
â¢ The API route calls the SDK's chatStream() â SDK lives in the same Node process.
â£ Around the SDK call, the route writes the user msg and (when done) the assistant msg to Postgres.
â¤ SDK opens a streaming HTTPS request to Gemini or Groq. Each delta is forwarded to the browser.
â¥ When the call ends, SDK builds a LogEvent and pushes it to an in-memory buffer.
 Every 1s a flush tick POSTs the batch to the ingestion service. If POST fails: exponential backoff.
â¦ Ingestion validates the batch with Zod, then XADDs each event onto a Redis Stream (pulse:logs).
â§ A worker on the same process reads from the stream via XREADGROUP (consumer groups = at-least-once).
â¨ Worker validates again, redacts PII (emails / keys / phones) in previews, bulk-inserts into ClickHouse,
 then XACKs the entries. If the CH insert fails, it does NOT ack â Redis re-delivers next loop.
â© Grafana queries ClickHouse (raw table + a 1-minute materialized view rollup) to draw the dashboards." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="290" width="500" x="80" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec-bg" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff8dc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="410" x="650" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec-title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Why the design looks like this" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="380" x="660" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec-text" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=4;" value="â¢ Postgres for chat, ClickHouse for telemetry.
 Postgres is great at "last 20 msgs for convo X".
 ClickHouse is great at "p95 latency by provider, last 24h".
 Trying to do both in one DB = slow chats OR slow dashboards.

â¢ SDK logs are fire-and-forget.
 A logging outage must never break the user's chat call.
 So: in-memory buffer, drop-oldest if full, retry with backoff.

â¢ Redis Streams between HTTP and ClickHouse.
 Decouples accepting events (fast, must not lose them)
 from inserting events (slow, batch-friendly).
 At-least-once delivery via XACK after successful insert.

â¢ PII redaction on the consumer side, not the SDK.
 SDK ships raw â ingestion is the trust boundary that
 decides what's safe to persist. Single place to update rules.

â¢ trace_id flows everywhere (SDK â Postgres â ClickHouse).
 Lets you jump from a Grafana row back to the actual chat." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="290" width="380" x="660" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
â User types a message in the browser.
â¡ Browser POSTs to /api/chat â Next.js streams the response back as ndjson.
â¢ The API route calls the SDK's chatStream() â SDK lives in the same Node process.
â£ Around the SDK call, the route writes the user msg and (when done) the assistant msg to Postgres.
â¤ SDK opens a streaming HTTPS request to Gemini or Groq. Each delta is forwarded to the browser.
â¥ When the call ends, SDK builds a LogEvent and pushes it to an in-memory buffer.
Every 1s a flush tick POSTs the batch to the ingestion service. If POST fails: exponential backoff.
â¦ Ingestion validates the batch with Zod, then XADDs each event onto a Redis Stream (pulse:logs).
â§ A worker on the same process reads from the stream via XREADGROUP (consumer groups = at-least-once).
â¨ Worker validates again, redacts PII (emails / keys / phones) in previews, bulk-inserts into ClickHouse,
then XACKs the entries. If the CH insert fails, it does NOT ack â Redis re-delivers next loop.
â© Grafana queries ClickHouse (raw table + a 1-minute materialized view rollup) to draw the dashboards.
